documents.title: Fine Tuning Notes
documents.snippet:
Fine-Tuning Notes (Feb 2026)

LoRA vs QLoRA
- Vertex AI Feb 2026 guidance: QLoRA reduces peak GPU memory ~75% vs classic LoRA, enabling larger sequence lengths/batches on single GPUs; LoRA remains ~66% faster and up to 40% cheaper when memory isn’t the bottleneck. - Hardware sizing (Introl Dec 2025): 7B models → LoRA fits on 24–32 GB GPUs (L40S/A100-40G), QLoRA squeezes into 12–20 GB (RTX 3090).

| Cloud | Use Case | Users | Primary Value | Data Inputs | Demo Hooks |

| Azure | **Field Service Incident Orchestrator** | Healthcare / Retail ops teams | Turns incoming incidents into triaged tasks, schedules technicians, pushes status updates | Azure IoT Central / Event Hub, Dynamics 365, Teams webhooks | Live kanban of incidents, auto-generated Teams updates, routing to on-call |
| Google Cloud | **Market Intel Signal Mesh** | Sales + Marketing | Aggregates news, filings, socials; enriches with Vertex AI RAG; pushes prioritized leads | Vertex AI Search, BigQuery, Pub/Sub ingest from RSS/Reddit, Looker Studio | Interactive lead cards, RAG-powered briefs, push-to-Slack demo |
